name: Superior Wire Harness
old_description: Custom wire harness manufacturers design and assembly tailored wiring systems, providing durable, high-quality solutions for industrial, medical, automotive, and all electrical applications.
about:
Superior Wire Harness is headquartered in Golden, Colorado, and has been operating since 1996. The company is an American-owned and operated business that began as a provider of custom wire harness and cable assembly services, expanding over nearly three decades into a full-service electronic manufacturing partner.

The company designs and builds custom wire harnesses, cable assemblies, electro-mechanical sub-assemblies, and electrical box builds. It also runs plastic injection molding and custom tooling operations, offering turnkey electronic manufacturing services (EMS) including PCB assembly, power cords, and sealed lead-acid battery integration. Production scales from prototype and sample runs to high-volume wire harness and cable assembly output, supported by domestic and offshore manufacturing options with USA warehousing.

Superior serves industrial, medical, automotive, and aerospace customers, as well as commercial and consumer markets. Its client base includes OEMs and ODMs requiring Tier 2 manufacturing, PPAP documentation at all levels, and UL/CSA-certified components.

The company emphasizes its “Superior Way of Manufacturing,” built on a quality system certified to IATF 16949, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, AS9100D, and IPC/WHMA-620 standards. It differentiates itself with in-house engineering support, all PPAP levels, custom tooling, and a logistics network that provides worldwide delivery from U.S. warehouses.
